name: push
js: (async()=>{const {useAppStore}=await import('/src/store/appStore.ts'); window.__p=(n,on)=>{const N=['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B']; useAppStore.setState(s=>({recentNotes:[{id:-Math.floor(Math.random()*1e9),note:n,velocity:on?110:0,on,name:N[n%12]+'4'},...s.recentNotes].slice(0,12)}))}; for (const n of [60,64,67]) { window.__p(n,true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)) } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); return document.querySelector('.viz-bar')?.getBoundingClientRect().height })()

name: style
js: (async()=>{ const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.viz-bar button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('🎨')); b?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return !!b })()

name: patch
js: (async()=>{ document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.viz-bar button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Patch')); b?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const q=[...document.querySelectorAll('.pd button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Quests')); q?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return !!q })()
